Exchange/platform: Bybit
Headline: [MENA exclusive] New VIPs: Unlock a 50% APR Boost and Earn Up to 1,000 USDT Extra
Start: 2026-11-03T00:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-07T23:59:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 1000 USDT
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Your VIP welcome comes with an extra boost. MENA users who become VIP members during the event period can earn up to 1,000 USDT in additional yield with an exclusive 50% APR Booster voucher for USDT Easy Earn Flexible Term plans, subject to terms.
## Event period: Nov 3, 2026 - Dec 7, 2026
How to Get Your Welcome Perk
Step 1: Claim the Task
Go to Rewards Hub and claim the Become MENA VIP task. [The task is only visible to users with MENA KYC verification level 1 and above.]
[Claim Now]<https://www.bybit.com/en/task-center/rewards_hub/>
Step 2: Become a MENA VIP
Complete the task requirements and become a VIP during the event period. This offer is exclusive to users in the MENA region.
[Become VIP Now]<https://www.bybit.com/en/VIPProgram/intro>
Step 3: Claim Your APR Booster Voucher
You can claim your APR Booster voucher in Rewards Hub 3 days after becoming a new VIP. The voucher is valid for 60 days.
Step 4: Unlock and Earn Up to 1,000 USDT Extra
Apply your voucher to the USDT Easy Earn Flexible Term plan to start earning additional yield. The more you invest, the more you earn!
[Earn Now]<https://www.bybit.com/en/earn/easy-earn/>
## What Is an APR Booster Voucher?
An APR Booster voucher increases the APR on USDT Easy Earn Flexible Term plans. Each voucher has a yield boost limit and a boost duration, which you can find in the voucher details.
For this welcome offer, the additional yield from the APR Booster is capped at 1,000 USDT. This cap applies to the boosted portion of your yield, not your principal or standard yield.
## How Does APR Booster Work?
- Boosted yield starts accruing from the next full hour after you subscribe with an APR Booster.
- The boost remains active until the yield boost limit is reached or the boost duration ends, whichever comes first.
- Additional funds added to the same plan while the booster is active automatically receive the boosted APR.
- Existing funds in the plan also start earning boosted yield once the voucher is applied.
- After the boost ends, the plan continues generating yield at its standard estimated APR.
## Example
For illustration only, if a USDT Easy Earn Flexible Term plan offers a 10% base APR and you apply a 50% APR Booster, the combined APR will be 60%, subject to terms.
If the voucher has a 1,000 USDT yield boost limit and a 30-day boost duration, the 50-percentage-point APR boost applies until the limit is reached or the 30-day period ends, whichever comes first.
Any additional funds added to the same plan during the active boost period automatically receive the boosted APR. Existing funds in the plan also benefit once the voucher is applied.
To learn more on APR Booster Voucher and Bybit Easy Earn, please consult Help Centre.
Terms and Conditions
- This offer is exclusive to users in the MENA region who become VIP members during the event period.
- The APR Booster voucher applies only to USDT Easy Earn Flexible Term plan.
- Users can claim their APR Booster voucher 3 days after becoming a VIP.
- The APR Booster voucher is valid for 60 days.
- Additional yield generated by the APR Booster is capped at 1,000 USDT.
- The APR boost remains active until the yield boost limit is reached or the boost duration ends, whichever comes first. Refer to the voucher details for the applicable boost duration.
- All participants must strictly comply with the Bybit Terms of Service. Bybit reserves the right to disqualify any participants who engage in dishonest or abusive activities during the event, including bulk-account registrations to farm additional bonuses and any other activities in connection with unlawful, fraudulent, or harmful purposes.
- Bybit reserves the right to modify or amend the event terms at any time without prior notice.
- Bybit reserves the right to the final interpretation of these Terms and Conditions. If you have any questions, please contact Customer Support.
